text:
Hi IF,

First of all, I want to say that, I couldn't do anything for our
PaleBlueDot as I was (and still have) some troubles in my life. So, I
consider that I don't have rights to advice you anything regarding Pale
or RTM.

Of course, according to above line, I cared first for my personal life.
But Does human become selfish or helpless because he cares only about
his personal life? or Because he is trying to make himself eligible
first to make a change?

If your legs are damaged, hands are broken, you can't run & give
helping hand to society according to my view. And this is why I couldn't
 do anything for our Pale and so for the society yet.

"Making ourself eligible first to help others & then turn the bad

can not become a tree & give fruits unless it eat the protein for

who didn't face problem while making good changes? There is no one who

hand when one or two finger of them is useless?

We need to use that same hand even one or two fingers are useless to fight & to make a change!

So, fight, We will fight to make a change!

I don't consider my self eligible to teach you or advice you because you

younger brother, I can at least aware you about the situations and about

Well.... I've watched a lot of the videos few years back. Shared them

projects... but only a handful worldwide... others are just doing PR.

To be frank it is impossible to see since we have been nurtured not to

author: jsr
text:
Hi Ifmyante

Many years ago I read a book by Harvey MacKay entitled "Beware the Naked Man Who Offers You His Shirt".

I lost that book, and I really don't remember much of it. But the thing I
 can't forget is the title. It makes sense to me. Everyone as individual
 must reach a level of understanding and results before trying to share
his/her ideas about something that is important.

This has been always the way I behave. I understand what Amit said
about growing first and then becoming someone who shares. Also I think
that at this moment you are asking for contributions in the form of
research and ideas.

Now, the thing is that I strongly believe each one of us must have a
personal and unique vision in life. What we must share is ethics and
values.

Also, in terms of colective knowledge and guidance, I've pictured many
times a leader as someone who is in the middle of the street, staring at
 something in the sky. Those who see him, become curious, and what they
do next is what defines the legacy of the leader: They stop watching
him, and begin to search in the sky the object that keeps that man
staring so firmly, and once they find it, they are able to evaluate what
 he was seing and why he was doing that. The fact that these people are
in the middle of the street is what make their actions evident to others
 and what inspires more people to do the same thing. But there can't be a
 permanent effect if there is nothing that attracts them to stay. Those
 who can't identify the target, will quit searching, and those who can
see it will stay as long as that object remains interesting for them.

The question now is: How can you make people stay?

At least, in my case I'm lost for the cause because in the frontpage I found this statement:Form a political party to become the government

I just can't make a commitment to follow a script that others write.
That's not me. And that is precisely what "political party" means to me.

I'm a stubborn man and I refuse to accept what I can't understand and
what I'm not ok with. So I also refuse to be "the blind guide leading
the blind."

This is the reason that I'm quiet in RTM. The discovering phase is just
for that. I'm discovering and I don't like to make others lose their
time because of my misreadings .

Anyway, I just want to thankyou for sharing your knowledge and your passion.

I hope you can achieve your goals in your project, even if I'm unable to follow that path.

author: jsr
text:
Ifmyante wrote:

I do wish you had read on just a little bit, and not decided upon my motives before I explained them!

The idea is to immediately call a referendum offering the people to
completely change the leadership structure; to take all the decision
making power from those elected, and give it to the entire population.

We, as a population, cannot take control of education, the media, or
anything else unless we, the population, become the government.

I thought I had made that very clear..........

IF, you are right. I was rude. I did not continue the reading. (And haven't yet)

Also, I did not explain myself.

I'm not questioning your motivations. I'm questioning history itself
and, I'm sorry, but I'm questioning the whole concept of "people in
government", because I know what it is like.

Facundo Cabral, "an argentine singer, songwriter and philosopher" ( according to wikipedia ), said once: "I have much fear of assholes, because they are many and can elect a president."

I live in Venezuela and I know firsthand what happens when uneducated
people decides about sensible matters. For the past 16 years we've been
under the curse of a government full of ignorant, corrupt and resentful
people, who have managed to ruin my country in every possible way. Take
this hint: The Venezuelan Central Bank is now a political entity and is
hidding the economic indicators because they are really bad.

All the public authorities are bound to a political party. There is no
division of powers. People's rights are not guaranteed. I can go on.

Their motto is "Now, Venezuela belongs to all" . The truth is the
opposite. They control everything and use it against us, the people.

The truth is even if you are in the right path, you can't guarantee those who follow you are equally motivated and prepared.

Leading with righteousness is an even more complicated skill to master
than learning to read the market. You need specialists with solid
understanding, not wannabes.

And you know there are some of us that have spend time trying to read
the market by it's true nature, and still need to forget old habits.

Multiply that "old habits" effect by thousands and you will get more
realistic odds against a project that includes uneducated people
performing sensitive tasks.

People will tell you that they understand, but they don't. They just think they've found a way to accomplish their own goals.

The only difference from today's structures, is that the old leaders at
least received an education. Many of the candidates that want to take
over only have an ideal, but are not prepared to handle the task, and
thus, with such people, the impending failure is unavoidable.

I think you need to use the same criteria that you use to enroll RTM
Fund traders, because if there are few traders ready to trade the fund,
there are even less people ready to manage a government

So, just as some people will need to assist to the RTM Academy in order
to really understand the market, most of people will definitely need to
get a very detailed education in order to change their views and become
useful to your project.
